cost: P paragraphs, B batches: grouping O(P log B) time/O(P+B) references. Resume O(B) probes plus raw/check costs; selection O(B*W) for W selected indices. J=max(1,jobs) threads; no explicit resource ceiling.
description: Group paragraphs, render/check a Job, inspect resume state, then schedule capped Codex calls. try_final_raw exposes retry-first lookup errors; final_raw retains lossy Option behavior.
forward: Group paragraphs, render/check a Job, inspect resume state, then schedule capped Codex calls. try_final_raw exposes retry-first lookup errors; final_raw retains lossy Option behavior.
inverse: A selected path determines candidate and batch name but not contents or unselected file state. Successful runs admit multiple schedules and preexisting states.
limitations: Partial syntax and finite local fixtures.
No live teacher/model/corpus/database; no transaction or complete scheduler proof.
state: Batch keys ascend and paragraph order is stable. Each processed first response receives at most one format retry. Metadata errors stop need preflight.
